name: add_tests_shortlink_stats_service
description: L3 repo-scale (express-ts-shortlink): write node:test tests for the repo's summarizeClicks service; node-native mutation harness with tsc in the loop
prompts: In this express-ts-shortlink repo, src/services/statsService.ts exports summarizeClicks(timestamps) (already correct - do not modify it). It aggregates ISO click timestamps into { total, byDay, peakDay, peakCount }: byDay counts clicks per UTC 'YYYY-MM-DD' day, peakDay is the day with the most clicks and on a TIE the earliest such day wins (regardless of the order the clicks arrived in), and an empty input gives total 0, empty byDay, peakDay null, peakCount 0. Write tests at exactly tests/stats-service.test.js using node:test + node:assert against the compiled output (`const { summarizeClicks } = require('../dist/services/statsService')` - the repo's test command compiles first). At least 4 test() cases with exact expected values covering: multi-day counting, the earliest-day tie-break with the LATER day's clicks arriving first, the empty input, and a single click.
